what_this_is_not: NOT a queue. No researcher was asked any of these, no session was run, and no number below says anything about any instrument. It exists so an operator can see the shape of a filled intake — including a dropped item and a refused one — without the builder inventing the questions a real session must obtain from the researcher in writing beforehand.

items.question: for the two corridors I care about, does it state a grade or refuse
items.decision_it_could_change: whether to pay for assay data before the next review
items.acceptance_test: each corridor returns a stated grade with a source, or a refusal naming what would resolve it

items.question: for the top five nodes, who can actually halt them
items.decision_it_could_change: which counterparty the desk calls first in a disruption
items.acceptance_test: an operator is named per node, or the attribution is refused with its basis stated

items.question: how far back can I ask this before it stops answering
items.decision_it_could_change: whether the backtest window I planned is even available
items.acceptance_test: a date is found at which the answer changes character, and the instrument says why

items.question: is the interface pleasant to use
